label: SKILL 1
head: Talk to strangers
sub: Barista, gym guy, the person next to you in line. One comment about something you both see.

items.head: Ask one question a day
items.sub: "Is that book any good?" Then actually listen.

items.head: Give one compliment
items.sub: On a choice, not looks: "Sick jacket, where'd you get it?"

label: SKILL 2
head: Speak in front of a room
sub: Meetings, toasts, presentations. The guy who speaks up gets remembered.

items.head: Speak in the first 5 minutes
items.sub: Say one thing in every meeting before the nerves build up.

items.head: Record a 60-second talk
items.sub: Phone on the shelf, pick a topic, watch it back once.

text: Both come down to *caring less* what people think of you.
